test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 24 Dec, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
In this question, two statements, I and II, have been given. These statements may be independent causes, or effects of independent causes or a common cause. One of the statements may be the effect of the other statement. Read both the statements and select the correct answer.

I. Martial arts like karate emphasize discipline and self-control, teaching practitioners to harness their strength for both defence and personal growth.

II. Karate is being made compulsory in every school.

options.text: Both I and II are effects of independent causes.
I is the cause and II is its possible effect.
Both I and II are independent causes.
II is the cause and I is its possible effect.

solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 2: I is the cause and II is its possible effect**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Statement I explains the benefits of martial arts like karate, emphasizing discipline, self-control, and personal growth, which are valuable traits for students.
 
• Statement II indicates that karate is being made compulsory in every school, suggesting an institutional effort to imbue these traits in students.
 
• The promotion of karate in schools can be seen as a direct response to the benefits highlighted in Statement I.
 
• This correlation implies that the recognition of karate's benefits (cause) leads to its mandatory inclusion in school curriculums (effect).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Martial Arts Training:**

 
 
• Martial arts training often includes physical conditioning, self-defense techniques, and mental discipline.
 
• Practitioners learn to respect their opponents and control their emotions during practice and competition.
 
 
 
• **Benefits of Martial Arts in Schools:**
 
 
• Incorporating martial arts into school curriculums can enhance students' physical fitness and mental well-being.
 
• It can also improve focus, concentration, and academic performance due to the discipline and self-regulation skills developed through training.
 
 
 
• **Government Initiatives:**
 
 
• Many governments promote physical education programs to improve the overall health and well-being of students.
 
• Making martial arts compulsory in schools aligns with broader educational goals of holistic development.
